court: High Court of Judicature at Madras
trial_court: D.V.C.No.6 of 2019, Judicial Magistrate, Vanur & Thiruchitrambalam
acts_cited_auto: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

acts_cited.act: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

facts_of_case: The respondent married the 1st petitioner under a false pretense that she was a divorcee. She had actually been married to Manivel in 2012 and her divorce proceedings were still pending when she got married to the 1st petitioner.

legal_principles.principle: A relationship in the nature of marriage under the Domestic Violence Act, 2005 must fulfill certain requirements and both parties must have lived in a shared household.
legal_principles.held: For a common law marriage: the couple must hold themselves out to the society as being akin to spouses; they must be of the legal age to marry; they must be otherwise qualified to enter into a legal marriage, including being unmarried.
applicable_acts_sections: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005 — Section 2(s)

legal_principles.principle: A concubine cannot maintain a relationship in the nature of a marriage.
legal_principles.held: As held by the Apex Court, a concubine cannot maintain a relationship in the nature of a marriage as such a relationship will not have exclusivity and will be monogamous in character.
cited_cases: Chandrasekaran vs Gajalakshmi, (2023) X SCC Y
keywords: relationship in the nature of marriage

legal_principles.principle: A person with a concubine cannot be considered an 'aggrieved person' under the Domestic Violence Act, 2005.
legal_principles.held: The status of the respondent in the life of the 1st petitioner can be rendered to be that of a concubine and the nature of the relationship of a person with a concubine cannot in any way be rendered to a relationship in the nature of marriage.
cited_cases: Chandrasekaran vs Gajalakshmi, (2023) X SCC Y

legal_principles.principle: A relationship that is not in the nature of marriage does not receive any protection under the Domestic Violence Act, 2005.
legal_principles.held: Though not a relationship in the nature of marriage does not receive any protection under the Domestic Violence Act, 2005.
keywords: relationship in the nature of marriage

outcome.final_order: The revision petition is filed to call for the records and quash the proceedings initiated against the petitioners.

keywords: Protection of Women from DV Act
